expectedPublicationDelay.delayDescription: Because of reporting delays, there is a gap of at least 90 day(s) between the publication date and published data.

temporalVariables.columnDescription: Temporal information of the value specified in the property 'valueCategory'.
temporalVariables.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of temporal value in the property 'temporal'. The sentinella year is derived from the sentinella week. Before 2024-05-27 (2024-W22) the sentinella week was used, thereafter the ISO week is used.

georegion.columnDescription: Geographical unit of the data record.
georegion.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of geographical unit in the property 'georegion'.

value.description: Represents the value defined by the property 'valueCategory' within the given temporal unit and grouping.

pop.description: Population number within the given temporal unit and grouping.

incValue.description: Incidence value within the given temporal unit and grouping. Based on non-rounded figures of value and pop.

prctConsultations.description: Percentage of doctors' consultations due to either influenza-like illness or acute respiratory infection (defined in the property 'valueCategory'). Based on property 'value'.

popExtrapolation.description: Extrapolated population number within the given temporal unit and grouping. For the current year, 'popExtrapolation' is extrapolated to a full year based on the number of days that have passed.

totalConsultationsExtrapolation.description: Extrapolated total patient doctor consultations within the given temporal unit and grouping.

deltaValue.description: Absolute difference in the metric 'value' comparing the current year to the last one.

deltaIncValue.description: Absolute difference in the metric 'incValue' comparing the current year to the last one.

incValuePrctChange.description: Percentage difference in the metric 'incValue' comparing the current year to the last one.

valueMean5y.description: Right-aligned, rolling 5-year average of the property 'value'.

trend.description: Indicates a trend of an entry with respect to previous entries. The trend is calculated using a poisson glm with a log-link with a right-aligned window of size 4 for the temporal_type year. For data by year the trend is adjusted by population size.
